messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Switch the camera setup to a close-up shot of the person's face from the front. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Change only the camera setup. Preserve the person's appearance, expression, and action, along with the existing scene. Use the provided reference image to determine the viewing direction, subject placement, and framing at the start of the edited video. Follow the camera setup and movement described above, and preserve the timing and progression of the action in the source video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"She stands facing the camera, blinks, and subtly moves her head and gaze, ending by tilting her head back and looking upward.","camera":"A static, medium close-up, eye-level shot that keeps her centered in the frame.","clothing":"A bright pink, off-the-shoulder top with a wide, rounded neckline and dark straps visible at the shoulders.","hair_color":"Light brown to auburn, with warm highlights on the right side.","hairstyle":"A short, straight bob with full bangs, plus two small, rounded buns or tufts of hair on top of her head.","identity":"A 3D-rendered woman with dark skin, a slender build, and a neutral-to-smiling expression that shifts as she looks around.","scene":"A futuristic, neon-lit environment at night, featuring a large glass dome with a glowing white ring, pink structural lines, and a circular teal light display behind her."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The output changes from a full-body shot to a centered medium close-up of the woman's face and upper chest. Her identity, hairstyle, pink top, futuristic neon scene, and general action progression are preserved, with the head tilt/look-up appearing near the end.
arguments.requested_change: Switch only the camera to a front-facing close-up of the person's face, using the reference for initial framing, while preserving appearance, expression, action, scene, and timing.
uncertain: Exact match of the initial framing to the provided reference image could not be verified pixel-by-pixel.
unexpected_changes: The framing is a medium close-up showing the upper chest rather than a tight face-only close-up.
